column1: ## P0-03 feasibility checks, run on the skeleton's own SMOKE runs, 2026-09-17.
## Three checks specified in the approved P0-03 plan and deferred twice. Each asks whether
## the benchmark is CAPABLE of showing the effect it exists to measure. A bad value here is
## a finding about the setting, not a reason to retune until it looks better.
## Generated by cnmfbench.skeleton (_fold_diagnostics); source run
## results/exploratory/p0skel-000-20260917/ (gitignored; this manifest is the tracked record).
## Configuration 000, scenario base_identifiable, SMOKE tier, seed 1701, panel_seed 20260917.
## NONE of these may be written to RESULTS.tsv: `silhouette`, `hvg_retention` and
## `poisson_error_floor` are not among PROTOCOL 5.2's 11 permitted metric names, and 5.1
## forbids writing a name not on that list.
## ---- 0. TRANSFORM AGREEMENT (the precondition for every number below) ----
## transform_rel_frobenius_vs_cnmf = 0.000e+00 in BOTH folds. The harness's s_g is bitwise
## the divisor cNMF used, so the held-out transform is in the same units as the dictionary.
## Confirms the reasoning from source: compute_tpm copies the input (cnmf.py:249), the
## simulator writes a dense integer X, and the dense branch is literally
## std(axis=0, ddof=1) (cnmf.py:542). The assertion stays in the RUN path, not the tests,
## because it guards a branch condition on an input property -- switching the simulator to
## sparse output would silently take the other branch.
## ---- 1. SILHOUETTE DYNAMIC RANGE -- PASSES. This was the gating check. ----
## Range 0.1146 (outer_0) and 0.0350 (outer_1), four orders of magnitude above PROTOCOL
## 1.4's 1e-6 degenerate threshold. The degenerate branch does NOT fire, so the baseline
## selector will not collapse to "always the smallest K" and the eventual 000-vs-100
## comparison is not measuring nothing. Precondition for `delta` meaning anything.
## For P1, not resolved here: the silhouette curve is MONOTONE DECREASING in K in both
## folds. That is exactly the shape PROTOCOL 1.2 warns about, and it is why the baseline is
## largest-among-stable rather than argmax -- plain argmax would return K=2 every time and
## feature A would beat it trivially.
## ---- 2. HVG RETENTION PER PROGRAM -- PASSES, in both directions. ----
## 0.77-0.85 of each program's markers survive into G. Not near 0, so no program's signal is
## filtered out before scoring (which would make the benchmark report "no difference"
## because the signal was gone). Not 1.0 either, which would mean Fano-based HVG selection
## had become a perfect oracle for the planted markers and the gene panel was unrealistically
## easy. Both failure modes are live at this scale and neither occurred.
## ---- 3. POISSON ERROR FLOOR -- PASSES AT THE LOW END, THIN AT THE TOP. ----
## The irreducible floor is computable exactly because the model is Poisson with known
## Lambda. Observed heldout_squared_prediction_error_v1 (equal_donor_mean) against it:
##     fold      floor/cell        K=2            K=3            K=4
## The curve is NOT flat by arithmetic: K=2 sits 18-22% above the floor, so under-fitting is
## clearly detectable. But at K_true = 3 the observed error is only ~5% above the floor, and
## the K=3 -> K=4 gap is 1.2% (outer_0) and 6.2% (outer_1) -- comparable to the headroom
## itself. READ THIS AS A CAPABILITY LIMIT: at SMOKE scale this benchmark can distinguish an
## under-fitted rank from a correct one, and has little room to distinguish K_true from
## K_true+1. Re-measure at DEVELOPMENT scale before any claim rests on the upper arm; the
## approved plan already flags that the overfit penalty scales as d_eff/|G_inf| and so
## weakens 11-fold going from 180 genes to 2000.
## ---- 4. CARRIER ASYMMETRY -- a property of this seed, recorded so it is not misread ----
## Identity program 2 is carried by 3 of 8 donors at seed 1701, so the two folds train on 1
## and 2 carriers. The folds are asymmetric in what the dictionary must learn BEFORE any
## method effect, which is consistent with outer_1's larger K3->K4 gap. The split is fixed
## deterministically from sorted donor_id and was NOT rerolled to balance carriers -- that
## would use ground truth to choose a split, which PROTOCOL 6.3 forbids. Read as a labelled
## diagnostic under 1.5.
## ---- 5. Section 4.3's exclusion path NEVER FIRED (0 cells, both folds) ----
## At |G_inf| = 50 and this depth no held-out cell has zero inference-panel counts, so the
## graceful-degradation code is not exercised by the smoke run and a bug in it would be
## invisible here. Covered by a synthetic test instead (test_splits_and_scoring.py).
